result.description: The NovaLume Aurora 34 is a fictional ultra-wide curved OLED monitor designed for immersive creative work and cinematic gaming. It features a 34-inch 21:9 panel, 3440 x 1440 resolution, 175Hz refresh rate, adaptive sync support, and a single-cable USB-C dock with 90W power delivery. The display emphasizes deep contrast, vivid color reproduction, and adjustable height and tilt for ergonomic desktop setups.
